mapper.select: SELECT issue_type, severity, count(*) AS cnt FROM migration_issue WHERE migration_run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY issue_type, severity ORDER BY severity, cnt DESC, issue_type

SELECT 'stg_user' AS table_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_user s WHERE s.migration_run_id = #{runId}) AS staged, (SELECT count(DISTINCT i.row_no) FROM migration_issue i WHERE i.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND i.table_name = 'stg_user' AND i.severity = 'ERROR') AS excluded, (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(s.inst_code), trim(s.legacy_user_id))) FROM stg_user s WHERE s.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_user', s.row_no)) AS expected, (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(s.inst_code), trim(s.legacy_user_id))) FROM stg_user s JOIN map_user m ON m.inst_code = trim(s.inst_code) AND m.legacy_user_id = trim(s.legacy_user_id) JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE s.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_user', s.row_no)) AS loaded UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_project', (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_project p WHERE p.migration_run_id = #{runId}), (SELECT count(DISTINCT i.row_no) FROM migration_issue i WHERE i.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND i.table_name = 'stg_project' AND i.severity = 'ERROR'), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(p.inst_code), trim(p.legacy_research_no))) FROM stg_project p WHERE p.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_project', p.row_no)), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(p.inst_code), trim(p.legacy_research_no))) FROM stg_project p JOIN map_project m ON m.inst_code = trim(p.inst_code) AND m.legacy_research_no = trim(p.legacy_research_no) JOIN project t ON t.project_no = m.project_no WHERE p.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_project', p.row_no)) UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_submission', (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_submission a WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId}), (SELECT count(DISTINCT i.row_no) FROM migration_issue i WHERE i.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND i.table_name = 'stg_submission' AND i.severity = 'ERROR'), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(a.inst_code), trim(a.legacy_regno))) FROM stg_submission a WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_submission', a.row_no)), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(a.inst_code), trim(a.legacy_regno))) FROM stg_submission a JOIN sub_mastinfo m ON m.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND m.regnoold = trim(a.legacy_regno) WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_submission', a.row_no)) UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_review', (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_review r WHERE r.migration_run_id = #{runId}), (SELECT count(DISTINCT i.row_no) FROM migration_issue i WHERE i.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND i.table_name = 'stg_review' AND i.severity = 'ERROR'), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(r.inst_code), trim(r.legacy_review_id))) FROM stg_review r WHERE r.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_review', r.row_no)), (SELECT count(DISTINCT (trim(r.inst_code), trim(r.legacy_review_id))) FROM stg_review r JOIN sub_review v ON v.inst_code = trim(r.inst_code) AND v.legacy_review_id = trim(r.legacy_review_id) WHERE r.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_review', r.row_no))

SELECT 'stg_user' AS table_name, trim(s.inst_code) || '/' || trim(s.legacy_user_id) AS source_key, '검증을 통과했지만 새 시스템에 사용자가 없습니다.' AS reason FROM stg_user s WHERE s.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_user', s.row_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM map_user m JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.inst_code = trim(s.inst_code) AND m.legacy_user_id = trim(s.legacy_user_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_project', trim(p.inst_code) || '/' || trim(p.legacy_research_no), '검증을 통과했지만 새 시스템에 과제가 없습니다.' FROM stg_project p WHERE p.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_project', p.row_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM map_project m JOIN project t ON t.project_no = m.project_no WHERE m.inst_code = trim(p.inst_code) AND m.legacy_research_no = trim(p.legacy_research_no)) UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_submission', trim(a.inst_code) || '/' || trim(a.legacy_regno), '검증을 통과했지만 새 시스템에 신청이 없습니다.' FROM stg_submission a WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_submission', a.row_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sub_mastinfo m WHERE m.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND m.regnoold = trim(a.legacy_regno)) UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_review', trim(r.inst_code) || '/' || trim(r.legacy_review_id), '검증을 통과했지만 새 시스템에 심의 이력이 없습니다.' FROM stg_review r WHERE r.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_review', r.row_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sub_review v WHERE v.inst_code = trim(r.inst_code) AND v.legacy_review_id = trim(r.legacy_review_id))

SELECT 'stg_submission' AS table_name, inst_code || '/' || regnoold AS source_key, count(*) || '건이 같은 원본 키로 존재합니다.' AS reason FROM sub_mastinfo GROUP BY inst_code, regnoold HAVING count(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_review', inst_code || '/' || legacy_review_id, count(*) || '건이 같은 원본 키로 존재합니다.' FROM sub_review GROUP BY inst_code, legacy_review_id HAVING count(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_user', string_agg(inst_code || '/' || legacy_user_id, ', '), '서로 다른 구 사용자가 새 사용자 ' || user_id || ' 하나에 연결됐습니다.' FROM map_user GROUP BY user_id HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT 'stg_submission' AS table_name, trim(a.inst_code) || '/' || trim(a.legacy_regno) AS source_key, '신청자 연결이 다릅니다: 기대 ' || mu.user_id || ', 실제 ' || m.applicant_user_id AS reason FROM stg_submission a JOIN sub_mastinfo m ON m.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND m.regnoold = trim(a.legacy_regno) JOIN map_user mu ON mu.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND mu.legacy_user_id = trim(a.applicant_legacy_user_id) WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_submission', a.row_no) AND m.applicant_user_id <> mu.user_id UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_submission', trim(a.inst_code) || '/' || trim(a.legacy_regno), '과제 연결이 다릅니다: 기대 ' || mp.project_no || ', 실제 ' || m.project_no FROM stg_submission a JOIN sub_mastinfo m ON m.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND m.regnoold = trim(a.legacy_regno) JOIN map_project mp ON mp.inst_code = trim(a.inst_code) AND mp.legacy_research_no = coalesce(nullif(trim(a.legacy_research_no), ''), '__VIRTUAL__') WHERE a.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_submission', a.row_no) AND m.project_no <> mp.project_no UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_review', trim(r.inst_code) || '/' || trim(r.legacy_review_id), '심의 이력이 다른 신청에 붙어 있습니다: 기대 구 신청번호 ' || trim(r.legacy_regno) || ', 실제 ' || m.regnoold FROM stg_review r JOIN sub_review v ON v.inst_code = trim(r.inst_code) AND v.legacy_review_id = trim(r.legacy_review_id) JOIN sub_mastinfo m ON m.sub_no = v.sub_no WHERE r.migration_run_id = #{runId} AND NOT fn_row_has_error(#{runId}, 'stg_review', r.row_no) AND (m.inst_code <> trim(r.inst_code) OR m.regnoold <> trim(r.legacy_regno))
